People: Roger de Rabutin Bussy (author, Wikidata Q733246), died 1693; Paul Boiteau d'Ambly (notes, Wikidata Q18011964), died 1886; Charles-Louis Livet (other, Wikidata Q15078852), died 1897. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Bussy, Roger de Rabutin, comte de, 1618-1693; Boiteau d'Ambly, Paul, 1830-1886 [Annotator]; Livet, Charles-Louis, 1828-1897 [Contributor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Histoire amoureuse des Gaules, P. Jannet [etc.], 1856, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/histoireamoureu01livegoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 62%, 38%, 67% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Paul Boiteau d'Ambly, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
